Governance-only function that sets fundManager[_address] = false.

Modifier requiring msg.sender == governance.
Modifier requiring fundManager[msg.sender] == true.

External call to recipient.notifyRewardAmount(address,uint256) executed after the token transfer in the same loop iteration.

External ERC20 balanceOf/safeTransfer calls in rescue transferring balance to governance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the governance state variable in the constructor.
onlyGov compares msg.sender against governance to gate privileged functions.
onlyFundManager looks up fundManager[msg.sender] for authorization.
msg.sender is emitted as the funder in DistributedReward.
governance state variable is read inside the onlyGov modifier.
fundManager mapping is read inside the onlyFundManager modifier.
onlyGov modifier guards execution of addFundManager.
onlyGov modifier guards execution of removeFundManager.
onlyGov modifier guards execution of rescue.
onlyFundManager modifier guards execution of distributeRewards.
_fundManagers array is iterated in the constructor.
Entries of _fundManagers are written into the fundManager mapping.
Local loop index i controls the constructor seeding loop.
_address parameter flows into the fundManager update in addFundManager.
fundManager[_address] is set to true in addFundManager.
_address parameter flows into the fundManager update in removeFundManager.
fundManager[_address] is set to false in removeFundManager.
_rewardToken parameter determines the token inspected in rescue.
_rewardToken address is used for the safeTransfer external call in rescue.
_balance local variable holds the queried token balance in rescue.
_balance is the value passed to the safeTransfer external call in rescue.
Rescued token balance is transferred to the governance address.
_recipients array parameter drives the distributeRewards loop.
_rewardTokens array parameter drives the distributeRewards loop.
_amounts array parameter drives the distributeRewards loop.
len local variable caches _recipients.length in distributeRewards.
Local loop index i controls the distributeRewards iteration.
amount local variable is read from _amounts[i].
rewardToken local variable is read from _rewardTokens[i].
recipient local variable is read from _recipients[i].
rewardToken is the token target of the safeTransfer external call.
amount is the value passed to the safeTransfer external call.
recipient address is the destination of the safeTransfer external call.
rewardToken address is passed to notifyRewardAmount.
amount is passed to notifyRewardAmount.
recipient contract is the callee of notifyRewardAmount.
The external notifyRewardAmount call hands control to an attacker-controlled recipient that may reenter distributeRewards before other state updates.
The external ERC20 safeTransfer call to an arbitrary token/recipient transfers control outside the contract and can reenter distributeRewards.
